title: Backend e2e failures explain themselves (HTTP status + error code, no secrets)
summary: V1 r3: failure notes use a fixed reviewed mapping of known auth, PostgreSQL and PostgREST identifiers. Unknown values are omitted, even if identifier-shaped; output codes come from mapping literals, not response text. Free-form keys stay excluded. Unregistered identifier-shaped canaries in error_code/error/code never reach notes; PGRST116 works in canonical case. Script-mode shared module identity retained. Live e2e UNRUN.
